name: iperf3 Client
description:
Run a client for iperf, a network performance testing tool. 
        [br]
        Provide the address of the iperf3 server to test network performance against in "Post Arguments" (enable Advanced View).
requires: Once started, this container will immediately begin testing network performance against the iperf3 server specified in the "Post Arguments" field. View the results in the container log.
